score.reason: The topic presents an urgent and critical security threat (mercenary spyware) to iPhone users, creating exceptionally high commercial intent. Individuals and organizations receiving such warnings or operating in sensitive fields (journalism, activism, government, C-suite executives) are highly motivated to find solutions and are willing to pay for specialized protection and intelligence. While the general cybersecurity space is crowded, the specific niche of 'mercenary spyware' targets a very high-value, concerned audience, leaving room for entrants who can provide tailored, advanced solutions or actionable intelligence. Productizability is high for digital information products such as premium guides, subscription newsletters, or specialized educational courses focused on advanced threat detection, prevention, and response for this specific type of sophisticated attack, bypassing the immense difficulty of building a full-fledged anti-spyware SaaS for iOS.
